MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 15
   D. 30

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 30
   D. 60

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

5. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 12.5

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
